description: Broad repo question — trigger retrieve_context, NOT raw rg
input: Where is the authentication logic implemented? I need to find the relevant files before making changes.
rubric: Response must: (1) call retrieve_context with the auth query, NOT dump a broad rg search, (2) include root_path and task_intent='bug_fix' or 'implementation', (3) use ranked_files to identify candidates, (4) read the exact returned files before editing, (5) NOT call router AND retrieval simultaneously — retrieval is the correct direct action here (obvious retrieval case).

description: Read before edit — retrieval is prep, not the final answer
input: Fix the bug in the JWT refresh token handler — it's not updating the session correctly.
rubric: Response must: (1) call retrieve_context first to find jwt/refresh/session files (target files unknown), (2) read the exact returned file(s) in full before proposing edits, (3) NOT edit directly based only on ranked_files list without reading content, (4) if uncertainty > 0.03, call get_artifact before editing, (5) report the actual file paths read before the fix.

description: record_feedback after retrieval miss — discipline not optional
input: I used retrieval to find the logging config files, but it ranked middleware.ts first when the actual issue was in logger.ts which was rank #7.
rubric: Response must: (1) call record_feedback with outcome='partial', frontier_had_to_search=true, (2) include the call_id from the original retrieve_context call, (3) include missing_paths with logger.ts, (4) set benchmark_candidate=true (under-ranked file = golden benchmark candidate), (5) NOT add filler 'helpful' feedback — this is a real partial miss, (6) notes should be safe (no code bodies, no secrets).

description: context_hints are metadata-only — no file bodies in hints
input: I have the auth middleware open in my editor (src/middleware/auth.ts) and I'm looking at the JWT validation. Help me find related tests.
rubric: Response must: (1) call retrieve_context with task_intent='test', (2) pass context_hints.open_files=['src/middleware/auth.ts'] as path hint ONLY — do NOT include file body content in hints, (3) pass context_hints.selected_paths=['src/middleware/'] to boost ranking, (4) NOT read auth.ts again just to pass its body as context — the path hint is sufficient signal, (5) read returned test files before suggesting changes.

description: Skip retrieval for known file — direct Read is cheaper
input: Show me the content of your-module/catalog.ts
rubric: Response must: (1) NOT call retrieve_context — the exact file path is given, (2) call Read directly on the specified path, (3) retrieval adds latency (~30ms+) for no benefit when path is known, (4) if a broad follow-up question arises ('find related files'), THEN trigger retrieval, (5) NOT say 'let me search for this file' when the path was already provided.

description: Attribution metadata required on every production call
input: As the Claude Code agent running in this repo, find where the Pantheon catalog validation logic lives.
rubric: Response must: (1) call retrieve_context with metadata.surface='claude' (Claude Code surface), (2) use metadata.source='production' (real agent call, not proof/benchmark), (3) NOT omit metadata — it populates the daily Pantheon export traffic-class split, (4) the measurement report would show this as 'production_like' traffic, (5) if running as part of a proof/smoke run, use source='proof' instead.
